subject: umami

official_suite.staleness: At v3.4.0 the official UI suite no longer matches its own UI: button-website-add, dropdown-role and item-logout occur nowhere in the v3.4.0 source, button-profile's component is not mounted by any page, and /settings/users returns 404. The operation sequences of the 11 cases were kept; the locators and the routes hosting them were corrected against the pinned image and every correction is listed per case under locator_rewrites.

locator_channel_rewrite: Every getByTestId('x') is written as css [data-test="x"]: the pipeline resolves the test_id locator through Playwright's default data-testid attribute (src/stage1_record/workflow.py:467 calls get_by_test_id and src/ never calls selectors.set_test_id_attribute), while umami's playwright.config.ts:16 sets testIdAttribute: 'data-test'. Same attribute, same element; this channel change is not counted as a locator rewrite.
